jobs.name: campainha
prompts:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit the first reference image into ONE final reusable AgentFlix editorial illustration PNG. The second reference is ONLY visual-family guidance; do not include its objects. Keep the target's meaning and recognisable silhouette. Use hand-drawn 2D editorial illustration, thin organic slightly irregular charcoal outlines, simple shapes, flat solid color fills, very few interior marks. Calm adult visual language. Palette: ivory #F0EEE6, charcoal #303633, muted cyan #65AEB6 as a single accent, sage gray #8A9690 only as support. No gradients, no specular highlights, no white shine streaks, no metallic/plastic rendering, no 3D shading, no shadows, no decorative badge/circle, no environment, no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Real transparent alpha background, not an opaque backdrop or drawn checkerboard; clean edges without halo. Output a single square asset with the complete subject centered, approximately 75% of canvas width or height, consistent safety margins. Must be readable at 48px as well as at 200px. Do not make a contact sheet or multiple variants.
TARGET: The restaurant service bell in reference 1. Preserve the ivory dome, low charcoal base and small muted-cyan push knob. Remove ALL curved white reflections, rim shine, bevels, cast shadows and lighting gradients. One flat ivory dome outlined in a fine organic charcoal line; one single flat sage-gray base with a charcoal edge, to remain visible on dark backgrounds; the cyan knob is the sole accent. Slight frontal three-quarter silhouette, but no rendered volume. Simple restful drawing, not a polished product icon.

Remove the entire background from this bell illustration. Deliver an actual transparent-background PNG cutout with RGBA alpha channel: all pixels outside the bell must have alpha 0. Keep only the bell. Background must be transparent. Preserve its ivory body, charcoal outline, sage base and cyan knob. Simplify color fills to solid flat colors. No background pattern, no checkerboard pixels, no shadow. Single centered object.
